title: Scaling limit of Sinkhorn-rescaled Random Matrices via Stability of Static Schrödinger Bridges
summary: We analyze the asymptotic behavior and scaling limits of large random matrices rescaled via the Sinkhorn algorithm to match prescribed row and column margins. For a random matrix with independent sub-exponential entries, we show that its Sinkhorn rescaling concentrates around the rescaling of its mean matrix, both at the level of the Schrödinger potentials and as random measures on the unit square, with explicit non-asymptotic rates.
